about/intro: I'm Nadav. My story is built like a game: scroll, and you'll level up all the way to today.
about/level01: I grew up in Be'er Sheva. From 14 I worked in renovations, and later as an emergency electrical and renovation technician. In the evenings I swapped the operating systems on people's phones: I put Android on an HTC HD2 with ROMs from XDA, gave remote support and wrote an article for TGspot. A Sony gamer for as long as I can remember, always into gadgets and the future.

about/level05: I fell in love with technology all over again. AI gave me the power to build on my own what I'd always wanted, so I stopped everything and dove in.
